title: Layered render plan
description: Input of src/layers/render-layers.mjs. Sizes in output pixels, times in frames of the timeline. Video takes are decoded on the GPU, cropped and positioned per frame, and composited under the graphics layer (a PNG sequence with alpha rendered by Remotion).

background.description: Solid color under everything, where no take covers the frame.

takes.description: Video takes, at most one on screen at a time, not overlapping on the timeline.

file.description: Video file: absolute, or relative to the plan file.

frames.description: Frames on the timeline. The last frame of the file holds if the file is shorter.

from.description: Seconds into the file where the take starts.

box.description: One [x, y, w, h] per frame: where the take is visible on screen.

video.description: One [x, y, w, h] per frame: the whole take, relative to the box. What falls outside the box is hidden.

audio.description: Audio files mixed by ffmpeg, each at its frame.

fadeOut.description: Volume falls linearly to 0 between these frames (relative to start).
